verdict.rationale: Mastra is a TypeScript framework for developers building their own agents. It does not ship a consumer assistant that everyday users meet in official web, desktop, or mobile apps, so this messaging-surfaces axis is a category error for the product. Studio is described as a developer interface for building, testing, and managing agents, not an end-user assistant app, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the assistant also meets me in official web, desktop, or mobile apps with feature parity beyond the chat basics
